title.zh: 五官科：局部穴加合谷，风池、完骨、天柱补益脑髓通清窍，咽喉分虚实，眼病重活血通目络并交代疗效界限
title.en: ENT and Eye: Local Points plus Hegu, Fengchi-Wangu-Tianzhu to Nourish the Brain and Open the Clear Orifices, Throat Split into Excess and Deficiency, Eye Disease by Activating Blood in the Eye Network with Stated Limits

summary.zh: 五官科的取穴由三层构成：官窍局部穴(迎香、印堂“鼻三针”，耳门、听宫、听会“耳前三针”，睛明、攒竹、太阳等眼周穴)，循经远端(合谷“面口合谷收”，足三里)，以及他从神经科带来的百会加风池、完骨、天柱“补益脑髓”——耳聋、麻痹性斜视、缺血性视神经病都用。治则按病位分脏腑：鼻病“补脾益肺”，扁桃体急性责肺胃、慢性责脾肾，梅核气责肝胃；咽炎与喉喑分实火(泻火、少商商阳放血)与虚火(降火、列缺照海)。眼病以“行气活血、通目络”为主，视神经萎缩“治疗周期较久”，并说明青光眼、近视、萎缩性鼻炎的疗效界限。
summary.en: Point selection in ENT and eye has three layers: local points at the sense organ (Yingxiang and Yintang as the "three nose needles", Ermen, Tinggong, Tinghui as the "three ear-front needles", Jingming, Cuanzhu, Taiyang and other periorbital points), distal channel points (Hegu, "face and mouth are served by Hegu", and Zusanli), and, brought from neurology, Baihui with Fengchi, Wangu, Tianzhu to "nourish brain marrow", used for deafness, paralytic strabismus and ischaemic optic neuropathy. Principles follow organ localisation: nose disease "tonify spleen, boost lung"; acute tonsillitis is lung-stomach, chronic is spleen-kidney, globus is liver-stomach; pharyngitis and hoarseness are split into excess fire (drain fire, bleed Shaoshang and Shangyang) and deficient fire (lower fire, Lieque and Zhaohai). Eye disease is mainly "move qi, activate blood, free the eye network", optic atrophy has a "long course", and the limits of effect in glaucoma, myopia and atrophic rhinitis are stated.

takeaways.zh: 官窍局部穴是五官科的底色：耳聋用“耳前三针”耳门、听宫、听会，依“经穴所在，主治所及”；鼻炎用迎香配印堂“为鼻三针之组合，治疗鼻炎效专力宏”；眼病取睛明、攒竹、太阳、四白、球后等眼周穴(11例眼病医案中9例)。远端首选合谷——“面口合谷收”，39例五官医案中合谷17例。
takeaways.en: Local points at the sense organ are the ground layer. Deafness: the "three ear-front needles" Ermen, Tinggong, Tinghui, by "where the point lies, its indication reaches"; rhinitis: Yingxiang with Yintang as "the three-nose-needle combination, focused and strong"; eye disease: periorbital Jingming, Cuanzhu, Taiyang, Sibai, Qiuhou (9 of 11 eye cases). The first distal choice is Hegu, "face and mouth are served by Hegu": 17 of 39 ENT and eye cases.

takeaways.zh: 他把神经科的“补益脑髓”带进五官：耳聋主穴百会、四神聪、风池、完骨、天柱，“三经配合使用，共奏疏通经络、行气活血、滋补脑髓之效”；麻痹性斜视主穴同样是风池、完骨、天柱、太阳、百会加肝俞、肾俞；缺血性视神经病变“针刺诸穴对各类眼部缺血类眼病均有良效”。39例医案中风池17例、百会13例；3例麻痹性斜视医案的治则都含“醒脑开”。
takeaways.en: He carries neurology's "nourish brain marrow" into the sense organs. Deafness: main points Baihui, Sishencong, Fengchi, Wangu, Tianzhu, "the three channels together unblock the channels, move qi and blood, nourish brain marrow"; paralytic strabismus likewise Fengchi, Wangu, Tianzhu, Taiyang, Baihui plus Ganshu, Shenshu; ischaemic optic neuropathy: "needling these points is effective for all eye diseases of ischaemia". Among 39 cases Fengchi appears 17 times, Baihui 13; all 3 paralytic-strabismus cases state "Xingnao (Kaiqiao)" in the principle.

takeaways.zh: 鼻病按肺脾、督脉分：急性鼻炎“宣通鼻窍，祛风散寒”，取大椎(“具有扶正、清热之功”)、肺俞、风池、迎香；慢性鼻炎“补脾益肺、活血通窍”，“治当培土生金，疏通经络”，大椎点刺放血；变应性鼻炎在迎香、印堂之外加蝶腭神经节、足三里、合谷，并配穴位拔罐敷贴与灸；萎缩性鼻炎“养阴润燥，宣肺散邪”，鼻窦炎“宣通鼻窍，化浊排脓”并用灸。16条五官全集处方中5条用灸。
takeaways.en: Nose disease is divided by lung, spleen and du channel. Acute rhinitis: "open the nasal orifices, dispel wind-cold", Dazhui ("supports the right and clears heat"), Feishu, Fengchi, Yingxiang; chronic rhinitis: "tonify spleen, boost lung, activate blood, open orifices", "earth generates metal, unblock the channels", with pricking-bleeding at Dazhui; allergic rhinitis adds sphenopalatine ganglion, Zusanli, Hegu to Yingxiang and Yintang, plus point cupping-plaster and moxa; atrophic rhinitis "nourish yin, moisten dryness, diffuse the lung, dispel evil"; sinusitis "open the nose, transform turbid and drain pus" with moxa. Five of the 16 complete-collection ENT-eye entries use moxa.

takeaways.zh: 咽喉分实火与虚火：急性咽炎“属实证，当以泻火为主”，风池、曲池、合谷、内庭加廉泉，“少商、商阳点刺放血，增强泻火解毒之力”；慢性咽炎“属虚证，治疗以降火为法”，取列缺、照海。扁桃体炎“关键在于肺胃”(急性，少商商阳点刺出血)，慢性则“关键在于虚证主要责之脾肾”，补太溪、三阴交、足三里；梅核气“关键在于肝胃”，疏肝解郁、行气散结，取太冲、合谷、内关、廉泉、天突；喉喑局部取人迎、水突、廉泉，远端病初取列缺、合谷、商阳、少商，病久取足三里、三阴交。
takeaways.en: Throat disease is split into excess and deficient fire. Acute pharyngitis "is excess, drain fire first": Fengchi, Quchi, Hegu, Neiting with Lianquan, and "Shaoshang and Shangyang pricked to bleed to strengthen draining fire and toxin"; chronic pharyngitis "is deficiency, lower the fire": Lieque and Zhaohai. Tonsillitis: "the key is lung and stomach" (acute; Shaoshang and Shangyang bled), chronic "the key is deficiency, mainly spleen and kidney", tonifying Taixi, Sanyinjiao, Zusanli; globus "the key is liver and stomach", soothe the liver and scatter binding with Taichong, Hegu, Neiguan, Lianquan, Tiantu; hoarseness: local Renying, Shuitu, Lianquan, distal Lieque, Hegu, Shangyang, Shaoshang at onset and Zusanli, Sanyinjiao when long-standing.

takeaways.zh: 眼病以活血通目络为主：近视“治当行气活血，畅达目络，舒缓眼筋，恢复神光”，眼周与头项穴加耳针、梅花针；视神经萎缩“着重在调补肝肾、活血通窍”，“临床常见坚持数月甚至数年而获效者”；青光眼“行气以利水，开通玄府目窍”；麻痹性斜视“祛风通络、活血牵正”，并按麻痹肌选睛明(内直肌)、瞳子髎(外直肌)、承泣(下直肌)、鱼腰(上直肌)。
takeaways.en: Eye disease is mainly about activating blood to free the eye network. Myopia: "move qi, activate blood, free the eye network, relax the eye sinews, restore spirit light", periorbital and head-neck points with auricular and plum-blossom needles; optic atrophy: "stress nourishing liver and kidney, activating blood, opening the orifice", "often needs months or even years"; glaucoma: "move qi to drain water, open the mysterious mansion and eye orifice"; paralytic strabismus: "dispel wind, unblock network, activate blood, right the eye", with points chosen by the paralysed muscle: Jingming (medial rectus), Tongziliao (lateral), Chengqi (inferior), Yuyao (superior).

takeaways.zh: 疗效界限写得具体：耳聋“听力损失程度越轻治疗越及时效果越好”；萎缩性鼻炎“无特效疗法，病程短者多能治愈，病程长者能够有效控制疾病发展”；视神经萎缩“应在解除或控制原发病基础上进行”；青光眼针灸“适用于经手术或药物治疗眼压控制良好者”，急性发作时“对控制眼压疗效不可靠”；近视“中度以上近视当配镜矫治”；斜视因疲劳、病毒感染者“一二周即可治愈”。
takeaways.en: Limits of effect are stated concretely. Deafness: "the milder the hearing loss and the earlier the treatment the better the result"; atrophic rhinitis "no specific therapy; short-standing usually cured, long-standing controlled"; optic atrophy "treat on the basis of removing or controlling the primary disease"; glaucoma acupuncture "suits those whose pressure is controlled by surgery or drugs", in acute attack "unreliable for controlling pressure"; myopia "moderate and above should be corrected with glasses"; strabismus from fatigue or virus "cured in one or two weeks".

evidence.quote: 患者听力损失程度越轻治疗越及时效果越好
evidence.src: 石学敏针灸全集·治疗各论·感音神经性耳聋 p.572

evidence.quote: 该病无特效疗法，病程短者采用针灸治疗多能治愈，病程长者能够有效控制疾病发展
evidence.src: 石学敏针灸全集·治疗各论·萎缩性鼻炎 p.581

evidence.quote: 针灸治疗视神经萎缩应在解除或控制原发病基础上进行
evidence.src: 石学敏针灸全集·治疗各论·视神经萎缩 p.592

evidence.src: 石学敏针灸全集·治疗各论·青光眼 p.594

evidence.quote: 中度以上近视当配镜矫治

caveats.zh: 这一科的条目多，其中前部缺血性视神经病变、视神经萎缩、急慢性咽炎等在全集的处方栏里配方字段缺失或残缺(OCR)，本指南的要穴以能核对到的原文为准。“蝶腭神经节”在原文OCR作“蝶聘神经节”，引文按原样保留。“鼻三针”“耳前三针”是原文的称呼。“翳风”等个别穴名因OCR残缺，仅在完整处引用。
caveats.en: Several entries (anterior ischaemic optic neuropathy, optic atrophy, acute and chronic pharyngitis) have missing or damaged prescription fields in the complete collection (OCR); key points here follow what can be verified in the text. "Sphenopalatine ganglion" is OCR-printed with a different character and quoted as printed. "Three nose needles" and "three ear-front needles" are the book's own names. Some point names such as Yifeng are OCR-damaged and cited only where intact.
